'''Gooth ball''' was a game played on a court. A gooth ball court was present in the [[Dim-U monastery/Legends|Dim-U monastery]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GG 7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
